### About Me
I'm Henry Yang, a student at Stuyvesant High School in New York City. I am currently a upcoming junior, and I've took interest in data science and statistics. This data science project is my final project for David Kane's Data Science Bootcamp (https://bootcamp.davidkane.info/). The goal of this project is to analyze the effects of social media campaigning, compared to email campaigning, on users and how they affect the probability that a customer purchases a product.
